variants.A: Frozen baseline with default OpenCV threads and per-frame registration
variants.B: Current FFmpeg path with selected threads, metadata reuse and batch registration
variants.C: Current PyAV path with the same selection algorithm and original-PTS extraction

method.cache: Fresh process and empty isolated outputs per trial; OS file caches uncontrolled. Trials were sequential with alternating order; no disk-cold claim.
method.elapsed: processing_wall_ms includes probe, scan, preview extraction, registry writes and plan validation/publication. Imports, isolated-library setup, verification hashes and report writes are excluded. trial_wall_ms also includes setup, hash verification and output-size enumeration. No job-queue progress/checkpoint persistence or model inference is measured.
method.cpu: Parent process CPU is measured directly; child CPU is sampled every 100ms and can miss short-lived children or their last interval. These are separate columns, not exact total CPU. Resource measurements include setup and verification hashes, beyond processing_wall_ms.
method.memory: sampled_peak_tree_rss_bytes is the maximum sampled sum of process-tree RSS at 100ms intervals, not a kernel high-water mark or unique physical memory; shared pages may be counted twice.
method.pts: Extraction verifies decoded source PTS before image publication, and plans pass timestamp and registry validation. Exact comparisons require all plan fields and every image hash to match. Saved final comparisons rehashed existing image files; summary generation does not rehash them.
method.frame_count: yielded_frames_including_preroll excludes frames discarded internally while seeking from an earlier GOP; legacy decoded_frames_including_preroll fields have the same meaning.
method.source_check: Source metadata hashes and file size/mtime snapshots remain unchanged; no claim of an additional whole-video content hash during each trial.
method.image_review: Contact sheets are local inspection samples, not an assertion of human review of every frame.
method.speed_statistics: Short clips use 3 runs per variant and paired reduction diagnostics. Full episodes use one run per variant with opposite order between the two episodes; no confidence interval is claimed.
method.background_activity: No other scan/model jobs were active; the idle application service and ordinary desktop/OS background processes were not isolated.

full_episodes.combined_reduction_definition: 1 - sum(candidate episode times) / sum(baseline episode times)

production.timing_note: Current-attempt metrics can describe promotion/reuse, partial recovery, or a new scan. They are not fresh-process benchmark timings and are never included in speedup calculations.

visual_review.finding: No visible extraction, framing, color or timestamp mismatch in sampled pairs. Stylized transitions and terminal black frames are present in both versions.
visual_review.limitation: Sampled sanity review, not exhaustive semantic ground truth. Exact plan and all-image SHA256 comparison is reported separately.

tests.backend_scope: keyframes, media, workflows, promotion, benchmark, retrieval sampling/jobs, concurrency, frame registry, backups, old-plan compatibility and recovery
tests.skip_reason: Three POSIX filename/legacy receipt cases cannot run on Windows.
